title: Cảnh Sobi Cloud: suối mây, vạc nấu, ô mây, nền trời
decisions: Cloud buildings stand on a cloud patch instead of the Farm grass patch (same rule, Area material). bg_cloud is declared in the manifest (CLOUD_BACKDROP_ART) but CloudScene still paints its sky in code: wiring the image is an integration step after acceptance.

sheets.name: W
sheets.title: Suối mây + vạc nấu + ô mây

hints.what: the Cloud Spring (a small pond sitting on a cloud)

cells.desc: Cloud Spring: a small round basin of smooth pale stones on a cloud, crystal-clear sky-blue water, a thin stream falling into it from a little stone spout shaped like a cloud, a few lily pads; taller than wide

Alchemist Cauldron: a round dark-iron cauldron on three short legs on a cloud, bubbling lilac potion inside with two soft bubbles, a wooden stirring spoon leaning in it, a tiny stack of firewood under it
Cloud Plot: a soft oval cloud cushion seen from above, wider than tall, with a shallow round bed of dark rich soil sunk in its top; this object IS the cloud, nothing stands on it

the sky garden of Sobi Cloud: a pastel morning sky (pale blue to warm peach near the horizon), a soft sun glow at the top left, a sea of fluffy clouds along the bottom, three or four small floating cloud islands with tiny trees far away, a faint rainbow arc in the distance
